steps.content: You come down into the crypt along a bare metal staircase. Up close, most of the facilities here seem long abandoned, but the scale of the structure is surprisingly big.

Intertwining rebar and iron sheets under the moonlight look like a magnificent forest of iron and steel. But the annual rings have been eaten through by rust and white sand has suffocated all vitality, and the place is totally forgotten.
You glance at Earl who's walking beside you.

options: I didn't know grand places like this existed in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...They do, and there are many of them. This is probably a desert warehouse built a few decades ago, made to cope with the huge logistic needs of the DisCity's exports.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: No need to look so surprised. Although Syndicate has become what it is now, over thirty years ago, it used to be the DisCity's true economic center and a mega industrial city.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Every piece of Hypercube extracted from DisSea was processed and went through the logistical and commercial preparation here. They were then shipped off to everywhere in the world with the West District's name printed on them.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Huge factories, warehouses, ports, and furnaces were everywhere. This place is only one of them. Its remote location has made it invisible, that's why it's still intact now.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: It hasn't been destroyed by gangs, only forgotten. It's lured in some suspicious punks to squat in here.

options: What led to the fall of the West District?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: A <color=#fb9259>massive explosion</color> blew up the mining area in DisSea, contaminating the lifeblood of the industrial city. The city went bankrupt and was abandoned, simple as that.
He smiles faintly.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Are you asking me all this because you've never studied the city's history, or you're really that unbothered by your own situation?

options: Info exchange with cooperating partners. Natural, isn't it?

steps.content: You know he's monitoring you. Although you've ended up here because you had no other choices, you figure there's no need to be too anxious or hesitant. Having fully understood the situation, you've made your judgment.
Both the origins of Suspect R and the Mania may be hidden in the depths of this crypt. You need information as well as power. It's beneficial for you to side with the Legion.
You'll make sure you have perfect control over everything. You must.

options: You said there was suspicious stuff down here. What did you mean?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I meant, mind your step.
Black sparks suddenly emerge from the ground on the right lane ahead. Next, with a huge blast, countless pitch-black spikes are snaking up from underground.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A trap?!

steps.speaker: Legionnaire
steps.content: Aha! Here they are, finally!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is not just an ordinary trap. It's been contaminated, and the energy that activated it is—Mania power!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are there other Sinners among the gangsters?
Several strange figures are hiding in the shadow. With weirdly-shaped canes in their hands and in bizarre outfits, their bodies are crooked in abnormal positions.

steps.speaker: Weird Woman
steps.content: Die... die, you jinxed curse of Syndicate... O divine punishment! Rain down upon thee! Thou Voodoos shall smite thee!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What's that power... Are they Sinners?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't be silly, those are just the clowning frauds of Thou Voodoos. They always say Sinners are demons and that we deserve divine punishment.
As you're talking, an entire magazine of bullets hits the iron box beside you. Behind you, several hidden gangsters jump on top of a rusty container.

steps.speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
steps.content: Haha! You've fallen for the trap. Die, die, die!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Humph, there are still Gonzales idiots left alive?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Their strategies are well coordinated. It seems like they're ganging up against the Legion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Beware of those weapons. They're unusually powerful and the attacks can activate traps. Be very careful.

options: But this is also a good chance.

steps.content: We should grab a few of those weapons. I'm curious about their power.
